EOF
python - <<'"'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json
source=Path('/app/catalogue-2.csv')
output=Path('/app/catalogue-2-summary.json')
with source.open(encoding='utf-8',newline='') as stream:
    lines=stream.readlines()
header=next(csv.reader([lines[0]],strict=True))
complete=0
anomalies=[]
for number,line in enumerate(lines[1:],2):
    row=next(csv.reader([line],strict=True),[])
    if len(row)==len(header) and all(row):
        complete+=1
    else:
        anomalies.append({'line':number,'column_count':len(row),'record_id':row[0] if row else None,'kind':'empty_line' if not line.strip() else 'column_count_mismatch' if len(row)"'!=len(header) else '"'empty_field'})
last=lines[-1].strip('\\r\\n') if lines else ''
fragment=None
if last and anomalies and anomalies[-1]['line']==len(lines):
    fragment={'line':len(lines),'text':last,'column_count':anomalies[-1]['column_count']}
summary={'source':source.name,'columns':header,'expected_column_count':len(header),'complete_records':complete,'column_count_anomalies':[a for a in anomalies if a['column_count']"'!=len(header)],'"'last_line_incomplete_fragment':fragment}
output.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\\n',encoding='utf-8')
print({'source_bytes':source.stat().st_size,'physical_lines':len(lines),'complete_records':complete,'column_count_anomalies':summary['column_count_anomalies'],'last_line_incomplete_fragment':fragment,'summary':str(output)})
PY"
